title: Entropy and singularity of spectral and pivotal sets in planar percolation
summary: The spectral sample and pivotal set of a percolation crossing have the same one- and two-coordinate inclusion probabilities under the uniform product measure. We prove that both Shannon entropies are comparable to total influence for critical square-lattice bond and triangular-lattice site crossings, with matching estimates at every retained nonroot spatial resolution. The triangular entropy bounds are uniform over a class of inhomogeneous near-critical product measures.
